scope: Read-only contributor-side native interface qualification and semantic-transfer blocker. No new synthetic trial, no native learning action, no owner mutation.
source_contract: NativeCausalAmalgam.observe_experience(identifier,views,row,source_sha256,packet_sha256) delegates to NativeCumulativeLearner, which admits pinned public staged episodes. Paired views contain two binary measurements per view. The public row fields are s1,x1,s2,x2,y; x1 and x2 are staged actions, s2 is an observed intermediate transition, y is an observed reward. Existing native checkpoint()/restore() and retention_guard.evaluate() are read-only qualification candidates.
research_mismatch: Energy Gates 15–21 train on arbitrary 5-bit direct input-context interventions x in [0,31] with binary XOR and AND outcomes. These do not automatically correspond to native two-stage public do-action episodes. In particular s2 is observed, not directly chosen as another action; no evidence proves a source-faithful semantics-preserving conversion of 5-bit direct interventions into native staged episodes.

native_owner_only_next_gate.hypothesis: Does retaining multiple causal hypotheses in existing native readouts improve held causal consequence predictions after witnessed episodes under the same native evidence without loss of existing capabilities?
native_owner_only_next_gate.pre_registration: Freeze the native source SHA/tree, parent checkpoint SHA, authenticated original public source, intervention policy and action budgets, retained-hypothesis representation and its byte budget, exact top-1 and fully trained conventional controls, intervention assignment, seeds/splits, held transfer and old-family windows, compute and stop thresholds BEFORE native first use.
native_owner_only_next_gate.native_operation: Only existing Amalgam owner can authorize a bounded native shadow comparison. Use StagedPublicReadout.first_action before observing transition, observe_transition, second_action before observing reward, observe_reward once with provenance-pinned public packet. Do not encode latent truth labels or hidden transition mechanisms as observed s2/y.
native_owner_only_next_gate.controls: Matched old witness prefix and newly revealed episodes, exact same actions/observations, full conventional Bayesian/posterior control, top-1 native control, capacity/compute and no-evidence/negative ablations, baseline native model. Read original forecasts before training.
native_owner_only_next_gate.checkpoint: Use NativeCausalAmalgam.checkpoint() and restore() with exact parent native/donor SHA, source identity, canonical bytes and append-only witness prefix; independently cold restore two processes and dual OS by sole owner. Snapshot and readout parity are necessary but not sufficient for retention.
native_owner_only_next_gate.retention: retention_guard.evaluate(anchor,candidate,historical_windows,max_brier_drift=Fraction(1,50)) is existing historical prefix diagnostic; also require fresh held familiar and novel-world function tests, interference and cold retention. No promotion based on historical probe alone.
native_owner_only_next_gate.scientific_pass: Predeclared lower Brier/correct intervention consequence relative to strongest fully fitted matched control, reproduced across frozen seeds/source splits and independently qualified, no unbounded false repair, no significant retained-known regression, audit-grade provenance. A testing PASS alone is not a gain.
native_owner_only_next_gate.authority: No acceptance, merge, runner, training, protected original first use, scheduled task, controller change or model checkpoint promotion from this contributor gate.

checks.source_pin: All five file contents fetched from the same Amalgam owner candidate commit, blob SHAs match repository bytes.
checks.functional_static: The public actions, observed outcomes, source packet, checkpoint and retention signatures are present; no assumption that mere API occurrence proves full behavior.
checks.direct_translation: FAIL_CLOSED_UNVERIFIED until an owner-pinned native witness-level mapping of the 5-bit source into staged public episodes exists and survives negative controls.
checks.promotion: BLOCKED until owner executes accepted native source-backed protocol and scientific/custody gates.
